base_prompt: Three people arrive at a workshop: Ada arrives before Ben, and Cara arrives after Ada but before Ben. Explain their arrival order and what each clue contributes. A response of around 80 words is enough.
text: Ada arrives first, Cara arrives second, and Ben arrives last. The clue that Ada arrives before Ben establishes that Ada cannot be last and Ben cannot be first. The clue that Cara arrives after Ada places Ada ahead of Cara. Its additional statement that Cara arrives before Ben places Cara ahead of Ben. Together, these constraints form the complete sequence Ada, then Cara, then Ben, with each person’s relative position determined unambiguously.
